simple.meaning: חֶלֶב (cheleb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fat , whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 92 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 4:4. Its contexts include birth, family, flock, offering, firstborn, sacrifice.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶלֶב (H2459).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֶלֶב (cheleb) / H2459 is traced through Genesis 4:4, Genesis 45:18, Exodus 23:18, Exodus 29:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: fat , whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part
definitions.full: H2459. cheleb I. חֵ֫לֶב noun masculine Exod 29:13 fat (Late Hebrew id., fat , so Phoenician חלב (probably); Aramaic (also diaphragm in Lexicons, see PS 1274 ) originally diaphragm, midriff ; Arabic , including midriff-fat , RS Semitic i. 360 ); — ׳ח absolute Lev 3:16 40t.; construct Gen 45:18 21 t.; suffix חֶלְבּוֺ Lev 3:9 6 t.; חֶלְבָּהּ 4:31 , 35 , חֶלְבָּם Num 18:17 , חֶלְבָּ֫מוֺ Psa 17:10 , חֶלְבְּהֶ֫ן Lev 8:16 , 25 (read plural noun חלביהן Samaritan Di); plural הַחֲלָבִים 8:26 7 t.; construct חֶלְבֵי 6:5 4 t.; suffix חֶלְבֵהֶן Gen 4:4 ( חלביהן Samaritan Di, compare Lev 8:16 , 25 above); — 1 fat of human body Judg 3:22 (covering intestines); גִּבּוֺרִים׳ח 2Sam 1:22 as smearing warrior's shield; of grossness of wicked בְּחֶלְבּוֺ מָּנָיו כִּסָּה Job 15:27 ; fat (of midriff) figurative of unreceptive heart ׳ח סָֽגְרוּ Psa 17:10 , see also 73:7 (read עֲוֺנָמוֺ מֵחֵלֶב for ᵑ6 ᵐ5 עֵינֵמוֺ מחלב Hi Ew Ol De Che Bae and others); לִבָּם כַּח ׳טָפַשׁ 119:70 i.e. their heart is as unresponsive as the midriff-fat near it. 2 fat of beasts: a. as rich food (poetry) Deut 32:14 and in simile Psa 63:6 (|| דֶּשֶׁן ); so ᵑ0 Ezek 34:3 (but read הֶחָלָב , see חָלָב ), 39:19 ( ᵑ6 Co בשׂר ). b. especially as offered in sacrifice, singular, to ׳י Exod 23:18 (JE), 1Sam 2:15-16 , Exod 29:13 (twice in verse); 29:22 (3 t. in verse); Lev 3:3 (twice in verse); 3:4 , 9 (3 t. in verse); 3:10 , 14 (twice in verse); 3:15 23t. Leviticus; Num 18:17 (all P), Lev 17:6 (H), 1Sam 15:22 ; Isa 1:11 ; 43:24 ; Ezek 44:7 , 15 ; see Isa 34:6 (twice in verse); 34:7 of fat of Edomites slaughtered by ׳י 's sword (under figure of lambs, rams, and bulls); as eaten by (strange) gods Deut 32:38 (poetry), not to be eaten by men Lev 3:17 ; 7:23-24 , (twice in verse); 7:25 (all P); also plural, fat parts or pieces Gen 4:4 (J) Lev 6:5 8 t. Leviticus; 1Kin 8:64 (twice in verse); 2Chr 7:7 (twice in verse); 29:35 ; 35:14 . 3 choicest, best part of products of land Gen 45:18 (E), specifically of oil Num 18:12 and wine 18:12 ; of corn and oil 18:29 ; 18:30 ; 18:32 ; also (poetry) ׳ח חִטָּה כִּלְיוֺת Deut 32:14 kidney-fat of wheat (i.e. the very choicest, compare Isa 34:6 ), ׳ח חִטָּה Psalm 81:17, ׳ח חִטִּים Psa 147:14 .
